text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered - PD#P12345 - service: allocator-queue-high - symptom: queue depth > 120k, enqueue rate > dequeue rate. runbook: /runbooks/allocator-queue.md

pagerduty-bot: Paging maria (primary oncall) — auto-ack window 15m. Incident classification: P1 capacity/backlog.

maria: Acked. I'm on it. @josh can you check autoscaler and node provisioning?

josh: looking now. HPA shows pods pending, autoscaler isn't provisioning nodes. kube events show node creation requests, then cloud API returns 403/QuotaExceeded.

andre: this smells like vCPU quota hit. we saw a similar failure mode last quarter. @evan any cloud alerts?

ev an: Cloud console has quota alert for project-redwood-inference us-west-2: vCPU hard limit reached (98% usage).

maria: customer impact: realtime-gen latency spiked to ~20s, ~5% errors for top 3 customers, dashboards show ~30 minutes backlog. Need immediate mitigation: options = route to dedicated, enable degraded model, or throttle heavy clients.

frank: I can route traffic to dedicated-1 pool. Need an ok to start switch and then manual node creation if needed.

maria: do it. frank start route-shift. also try manual node provisioning as fallback, but quota likely blocks it.

frank: starting route shift now. command I'm running:
```bash
# switch allocator service to dedicated pool
kubectl patch svc allocator --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/selector/pool","value":"dedicated-1"}]'
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: allocator-routing v2 started rollout.

josh: manual node create attempt returned: `RequestFailed: QuotaExceeded: Requested vCPUs 32 exceeds quota 0 for project` — project doesn't have any additional vCPU quota available in region.

andre: emergency quota increases typically take ~1-2 hours. not useful for immediate fix. need short-term traffic controls.

maria: Plan B enacted: throttle top heavy clients + enable small-model fallback for non-critical traffic. frank, please apply traffic throttle flag.

frank: applying throttle via feature flag. endpoint hit to flagger: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://flagger.internal/api/flags/throttle -d '{"service":"allocator","top_clients":5,"limit_per_min":200}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
```

frank: throttle in. started shifting ~30% of non-SLA traffic to compact-model-v1.

josh: early telemetry: queue 120k -> 85k within 5m after throttle + route shift. dequeue rate up ~3x on dedicated pool. errors dropping.

ev an: monitoring: 5m latency median down from 18s to 9s, error rate down to ~2%. catching more metrics in datadog.

maria: Good. Open PD escalation to platform for quota lift and follow-up ticket. We need permanent remedy (quota, autoscaler retry/backoff adjustments, runbook update).

pagerduty-bot: PD update: Escalated to platform team (platform@redwood) for emergency quota increase. Incident assigned to P1.

andre: noted. I'll prepare a short checklist for postmortem: 1) quota visibility in alerts, 2) autoscaler fallback to pooled on-demand nodes, 3) runbook step to flip traffic earlier.

frank: route shift fully applied — dedicated-1 handling 70% of load now. queue continuing to drain: 85k -> 60k -> 42k over next 20m.

josh: still seeing some stuck pods with imagepull backoff on a small subset — investigating but not blocking drain.

maria: Update 15:30 UTC: queue ~42k, latency stabilizing ~5-7s, errors ~0.8% for affected customers. I'll hand off monitoring at 16:00 to evan. leaving runbook updates to andre.

ev an: Acked for handoff. I'll keep an eye and coordinate with platform on quota progress. Set calendar for remediation follow-up.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated (partial): immediate customer impact reduced via routing+throttle. Action items: platform quota request (in progress), runbook update, permanent autoscaler/backoff changes. Please file postmortem and link here.

maria: filing postmortem now — will include timeline and mitigation notes. tagging @product-support for customer comms.

frank: leaving thread — will be on standby if route needs rollback.

ev an: I'll monitor until cleared and update when backlog is <5k for 30m.

maria: thanks team. Great quick work.
